# Test-only fonts

`SheetstampTest-*.ttf` is the family "Sheetstamp Test": a subset of Liberation Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1,
Copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation, with Reserved Font Name Arimo; Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc., with
Reserved Font Name Liberation), renamed because the licence reserves the original name. Rebuild with
`make-test-fonts.py`. Used only by automated tests; never shipped in the installer.
